channel.title: depmedic blog
channel.description: Notes on cheaper, faster, less leaky CI. Free CLIs and a small set of paid playbooks.

item.title: I scanned 5 popular OSS repos in 5 minutes. Here's what I found.
item.description: vite, prettier, axios, svelte, eslint - 50 workflows scanned via the new in-browser /scan.html tool. 158 ci-doctor findings, ~$6,279/mo modeled CI spend, the same three smells in all five repos.

item.title: A .cursorrules that actually fits your stack.
item.description: cursor-rules-init scaffolds a starter .cursorrules / AGENTS.md / system prompt for Cursor, Claude Code, and ChatGPT. Stack-aware: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Python, Node servers.

item.title: How much does my GitHub Actions workflow cost?
item.description: Estimate GitHub Actions workflow cost in dollars from the YAML alone. gha-budget reads jobs, expands matrices, applies the official runner pricing, and projects monthly spend.

item.title: GitHub Actions linters compared: actionlint, ci-doctor, sherif, octoscan
item.description: Comparison of the four open-source GitHub Actions linters in 2026: actionlint, ci-doctor, sherif, and octoscan. What each one catches, where each one stops, and how to combine them.

item.title: npm audit without the noise. depmedic triages instead.
item.description: npm audit reports every CVE in every transitive dep regardless of reachability. depmedic prioritizes by reachability, severity, and fix availability. CI-friendly exit codes.

item.title: What 20 popular OSS projects pay for GitHub Actions
item.description: Pulled the live workflow YAML from React, Next.js, Deno, TypeScript, Vite and 15 more, priced every job, ran ci-doctor against all of them. 229 workflows, 944 real CI smells, modeled ~$51k/mo combined spend at 30 runs/day. Public methodology and dataset.

item.title: Pin every GitHub Action to a SHA. One command.
item.description: Tags are mutable. Branches are mutable. SHAs are not. pin-actions rewrites every uses: line in your workflows to a full commit SHA. Supply chain hardening in one command.

item.title: Stop linting your GitHub Actions. Fix them.
item.description: ci-doctor 0.2 ships --fix mode: auto-applies safe fixes for missing-permissions, missing-concurrency, missing-timeout, and artifact-no-retention. Comments preserved.
